title: The Town Crier
text: A faceless crier rings his bell in an empty square, the sound echoing off blank walls. In a clear and cheerful voice he calls out news of your own House, things no one should know. Shutters creak open to listen.

options.label: Listen to his news and learn what else he knows.

outcomes.text: He cries a rival's troubles for anyone to hear.
He cries news of your own that has not happened yet.

options.label: The shrewdest pays him to cry a lie about a rival.

outcomes.text: The faceless will repeat it everywhere, as cheerfully as he did.

options.label: The Leader silences him before he cries anything more about the House.

outcomes.text: The bell stops. The square fills with the faceless.
